purpose: Teach: ハンサム/ニコチン/馬力/ハイウェイ/アスファルト/鰻/怪談/ニンジン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、写真でハンサムに写ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Your dad looks so handsome in that photo, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Soft voice pitched toward the child. A small smile behind the words—the kind an older sister gives when she's noticing something sweet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがニコチンガムで頑張ってるって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's trying really hard with the nicotine gum.
lines.style: Quiet observation, matter-of-fact but gentle. No judgment—just noticing something adults are doing. Pause before speaking, like he's been thinking about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが馬力のある新車を買われたわ
lines.en: That's true, Sho. Your dad got himself a powerful new car.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment, almost to herself at first. Gentle agreement with the child's unspoken thought. Warm and slightly amused at the simple truth of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとハイウェイ走りたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to drive on the highway with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, bright, but with a small note of longing underneath. Not demanding—hopeful. The way a child asks for something he really wants but isn't sure he'll get.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭をアスファルト舗装にすると簡単になるわね
lines.en: Well, we could always pave over the garden and make it easier, couldn't we.
lines.style: Teasing but tender—gently absurd. A knowing smile in the voice. She's playing with him, deflecting his longing with gentle humor, the way someone protective does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと鰻のお店に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the eel restaurant with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager without self-consciousness. The simple want of a young child. Natural rhythm, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、夏休みに怪談を聞きに行きましょうね
lines.en: How about we go hear some ghost stories together during summer break?
lines.style: Animated and inviting, like she's offering him something special. Warm energy that includes him in something bigger. An older sister making him feel wanted.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ニンジンが嫌いだけど食べるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't like carrots, but I'll eat them anyway.
lines.style: Serious and sincere, the way a small child states something he's decided matters. No complaint—determination. Looking her in the eye with quiet resolve.
